neighbours.label: the word after 'National' (or 'National Security') in the name of a national institution or statute
fire: The strike was settled under the National Labor Relations Act of 1935.
Korea National Oil plans to buy a refinery in Canada next year.
The FBI issued a National Security Letter to the phone company.
Her article appeared in the National Security Law Report last spring.
The Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation signed the new contract.
Funding comes from the National Science Foundation in Washington.
He worked for the National Weather Service for thirty years.
The National Health Service hired more nurses this winter.
quiet: The strike was settled after three weeks of talks in 1935.
The Korean oil company plans to buy a refinery in Canada next year.
The FBI sent a formal letter to the phone company last week.
Her article appeared in a law review last spring.
The Nigerian oil company signed the new contract on Monday.
Funding comes from a private donor in Washington.
He worked as a weather forecaster for thirty years.
The city hospital hired more nurses this winter.

notes: card: National Labor Relations, National Oil, National Security Letter / Law; other examples are second words of institution names
